title: Design and Implementation of a Nutritional Intervention in Patients With Oropharyngeal Dysphagia
brief_summary: The purpose of this trial is to design, implement and evaluate the effect of a nutritional intervention in patients with Oropharyngeal Dysphagia on body composition and oral intake of energy and protein.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of Oropharyngeal Dysphagia.
* Patients who have primary caregiver.
* Agreeing to participate in the study.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Critically ill patients.
* Chronic kidney disease with Glomerular Filtration Rate \<30 ml / min or in renal replacement therapy
* Liver failure.
* Cancer with active radiotherapy or chemotherapy treatment.
* Patients who are participating in another study.
